undeploy.retained: Kept: the Skill, its version history and other deployment relations in the library are unaffected.
undeploy.recovery: Recovery: redeploying the same Skill rebuilds the copy at the target.

library.healthScope: The health check only looks for unfinished application operations (such as interrupted imports or deployments) and offers recovery/repair paths. It does not include duplicate or same-name detection (duplicate analysis runs during import), content validation, or deployment consistency checks.

llm.capabilitiesDescription: Every capability is off by default; the matching feature only calls a model service after you explicitly enable it. Configure an LLM provider above first.
llm.capabilityDisabled: The AI capability for this feature is disabled; enable it in Settings and try again.
llm.scopeSafety: Sends: skill file contents (after masking sensitive values)
llm.defaultOfflineNote: All AI capabilities are off by default and local features are unaffected; while the network master switch is off, no model request is made even if a capability is enabled.
llm.providersDescription: Configure model service access. Credentials live in the operating system credential store; the database and export files only keep references, never secret material.
llm.credentialNote: The key is written only to this machine's OS credential store; leave empty to keep the stored credential.
llm.prereqEndpointNeeded: Fill in the API address (Base URL) before fetching models or testing this configuration.
llm.prereqCredentialNeeded: Online providers need an API key (or a stored credential) before fetching models or testing this configuration.
llm.deleteConfirmDescription: This removes the "{{label}}" configuration and drops the key reference from the OS credential store.
llm.modelFailed: Model connection failed ({{code}}); reachability alone does not prove the model works
llm.clearCredentialConfirmDescription: Only remove the key for “{{label}}” from this machine's credential store; keep the provider configuration.
llm.credentialCleared: Credential cleared. The provider configuration was kept.
llm.notConfigured: No usable LLM provider is configured yet. Add and enable a provider first.
llm.credentialUnavailable: The credential is unavailable and may have been cleared. Enter the API key again.
llm.credentialReadFailed: The local credential could not be read. Check credential-store permissions and retry.
llm.endpointUnreachable: The model service could not be reached. Check the API address and network settings.
llm.evidenceReferenceInvalid: The model returned an invalid evidence reference; this AI result was ignored and the deterministic flow is unaffected.
llm.endpointNotAllowed: This model-service address is not allowed. Check the API address.
llm.authFailed: The model service rejected the credential. Check the API key and try again.
llm.modelNotFound: The model was not found or is not supported by this provider.
llm.rateLimited: The model service is rate-limiting requests. Try again later.
llm.requestTimeout: The model service request timed out. Check the network and try again.
llm.serverError: The model service returned a server error. Try again later.
llm.inputTooLarge: The payload exceeds the model service's size limit; shorten it and try again.
llm.invalidJson: The model service returned unreadable data. Check the provider protocol.
llm.invalidResponse: The model service returned an unexpected result. Check the provider protocol.
llm.responseInterrupted: The model service response was interrupted. Try again.
llm.protocolIncompatible: The model service protocol is incompatible. Check the provider configuration.

uninstall.heading: Uninstall preparation
uninstall.description: Select deployments, preview the impact, then tick each action you want to run. Unticked actions never run.
uninstall.scenario: When to use this: when you no longer want SkillHub to manage a Skill that is deployed to Agents/projects. You can optionally back up first, undeploy everything, leave target folders as independent copies, and clear local data or credentials; the central library is preserved by default and your Agent's own files are never deleted. With no deployments there is nothing to manage here.
uninstall.preservesYes: The central Skill library will be preserved.
uninstall.preservesNo: The central Skill library will not be preserved.
uninstall.actionsHeading: Available actions (nothing is selected by default)

retention.heading: Rolling backup & retention
retention.description: Creates a full backup under the retention policy and removes history beyond the kept count.
retention.cacheNote: Cache cleanup: stale repository-discovery downloads older than 24 hours are removed automatically before the next download; the central library has no cache that needs manual cleanup.
